title: Ledger: canonical-safe CPU in inventory rows (cpu_us) and a non-launch RECEIPT row kind
objective: Make ledger.inventory() rows canonical JSON (integer cpu_us, no floats) and add a RECEIPT row kind that charges CPU/bytes but not launches.
problem: Escalations C-004-T024_1 and _2 (Argus): receipt.canonical_bytes refuses floats (draft B B2), so a real RUN_INVENTORY cannot be hashed for custody; and per-receipt TOP_LEVEL rows would spend 25 of 12 launches. Inventory rows: replace float cpu_s with integer microseconds cpu_us (store may keep its float). New LAUNCH_KIND 'RECEIPT': counted for CPU and bytes, not for launches; rows carry node_id (V7).
non_goals: No change to cap values or to G-INV
Do not reinterpret what counts toward caps beyond the RECEIPT kind
evidence_required: RED: a test that receipt.canonical_bytes(inventory rows) succeeds, failing on the float before the fix
a test that 25 RECEIPT rows after one TOP_LEVEL row charge 1 launch and their summed CPU
existing ledger tests still pass (adjusted only where cpu_s became cpu_us)

acceptance.condition: inventory canonical-safe; RECEIPT kind charged CPU not launches; suite green

authority: operator directive 2026-10-03 s9, s11; escalation responses C-004-T024_1_2_RESPONSE.md
